entries.description: Blackberries at peak, ripe fruits everywhere
entries.childFriendlyNote: Free sweets from the hedge! Pick the fat shiny black ones — red ones are sour, black ones burst with purple juice

entries.description: Harvest spiders abundant on fences, walls and vegetation
entries.childFriendlyNote: A tiny round body on super-long bouncy legs — it looks like a walking dot! Gentle, they don't bite

entries.description: Bright red rosehips decorating hedgerows, rich in vitamin C
entries.childFriendlyNote: Shiny red berries on the prickly rose bushes — birds love them and people used to make syrup from them

entries.description: Conkers falling from trees, spiky green cases splitting open
entries.childFriendlyNote: Crack open the spiky green shell to find a beautiful shiny brown conker inside — they feel so smooth!

entries.description: Garden spiders building large orb webs, dew-covered webs visible at dawn
entries.childFriendlyNote: Giant sparkly webs covered in dew drops like diamond necklaces — the spider sits right in the middle waiting

entries.description: Swallows gathering on wires and rooftops, preparing for migration
entries.childFriendlyNote: Hundreds of swallows sit on the wires like musical notes — they're getting ready for their BIG journey to Africa

entries.description: Ivy beginning to flower, pale green globular clusters attracting late insects
entries.childFriendlyNote: Buzzing green flowers that bees and butterflies love — ivy is like a last cafe before winter!

entries.description: Blackberries at peak, ripe fruits everywhere
entries.childFriendlyNote: Free sweets from the hedge! Pick the fat shiny black ones — red ones are sour, black ones burst with purple juice

entries.description: Harvest spiders abundant on fences, walls and vegetation
entries.childFriendlyNote: A tiny round body on super-long bouncy legs — it looks like a walking dot! Gentle, they don't bite

entries.description: Bright red rosehips decorating hedgerows, rich in vitamin C
entries.childFriendlyNote: Shiny red berries on the prickly rose bushes — birds love them and people used to make syrup from them

entries.description: Conkers falling from trees, spiky green cases splitting open
entries.childFriendlyNote: Crack open the spiky green shell to find a beautiful shiny brown conker inside — they feel so smooth!

entries.description: Garden spiders building large orb webs, dew-covered webs visible at dawn
entries.childFriendlyNote: Giant sparkly webs covered in dew drops like diamond necklaces — the spider sits right in the middle waiting

entries.description: Swallows gathering on wires and rooftops, preparing for migration
entries.childFriendlyNote: Hundreds of swallows sit on the wires like musical notes — they're getting ready for their BIG journey to Africa

entries.description: Ivy beginning to flower, pale green globular clusters attracting late insects
entries.childFriendlyNote: Buzzing green flowers that bees and butterflies love — ivy is like a last cafe before winter!

entries.description: Blackberries at peak, ripe fruits everywhere
entries.childFriendlyNote: Free sweets from the hedge! Pick the fat shiny black ones — red ones are sour, black ones burst with purple juice

entries.description: Harvest spiders abundant on fences, walls and vegetation
entries.childFriendlyNote: A tiny round body on super-long bouncy legs — it looks like a walking dot! Gentle, they don't bite

entries.description: Bright red rosehips decorating hedgerows, rich in vitamin C
entries.childFriendlyNote: Shiny red berries on the prickly rose bushes — birds love them and people used to make syrup from them

entries.description: Conkers falling from trees, spiky green cases splitting open
entries.childFriendlyNote: Crack open the spiky green shell to find a beautiful shiny brown conker inside — they feel so smooth!

entries.description: Garden spiders building large orb webs, dew-covered webs visible at dawn
entries.childFriendlyNote: Giant sparkly webs covered in dew drops like diamond necklaces — the spider sits right in the middle waiting

entries.description: Swallows gathering on wires and rooftops, preparing for migration
entries.childFriendlyNote: Hundreds of swallows sit on the wires like musical notes — they're getting ready for their BIG journey to Africa

entries.description: Ivy beginning to flower, pale green globular clusters attracting late insects
entries.childFriendlyNote: Buzzing green flowers that bees and butterflies love — ivy is like a last cafe before winter!
